text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, as I'm walking past the dorm...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, Trainer! Let's have a good
ol'-fashioned
barbecue!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yessiree! My folks sent over some juicy
steaks!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Meat from the US is so succulent and
tender. The
juice has some real flavor to
it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Food like this is best served with a whole
bunch
of folks diggin' in. That's that
famous Japanese
hospitality!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So are ya down to party, Trainer? Better
get on
board, 'cause we're blastin' off
sky-high to meaty
heaven!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
A safe diet? You sayin' I need to take
care of my
health?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hm, I reckon I should be watchin' what I eat. Too much meat and I might as well be the fat on a sirloin...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll try to rein it in. I can make
do with
just two or three pounds of
steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her efforts to cut back, Taiki
Shuttle eats
a fair amount of meat,
leaving her stomach full
and her vitality
high.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right, you better hold on tight!
'Cause we're
racing to see who can
gobble down the most
steak!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And don't worry your head none about
eatin' too
much! They sent it in bulk!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I reckon everybody's down to dine and
dash
today! Or is it dine till ya drop?
Either way, let's
eat till our bellies burst!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We end up devouring a mountain of
meat
together. My stomach manages to
remain intact,
but I expect my weight to
rocket upwards.
